Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Communication Officer position supporting the GEMS program at Atlas Copco Airpower. With a background in digital marketing, content creation, and web management, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to a global transformation project.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I create clear, engaging content and manage communication plans for diverse audiences. I am skilled in turning complex topics into accessible messages, coordinating projects, and using tools like PowerPoint, SharePoint, and Forms. My experience with international teams and my proactive approach to planning and follow-up align well with the requirements of this role.

I am fluent in English and have a B1 level in Dutch, with additional languages being a plus. I am eager to bring my positive energy and communication skills to support the roll-out across China, Italy, Spain, and the UK.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Communication Officer position at Atlas Copco Airpower, supporting the global GEMS program. As a junior digital marketer with a strong foundation in content creation, web management, and cross-cultural communication, I am drawn to this role's focus on turning complex subject matter into engaging messages for diverse international teams.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed my ability to craft clear, targeted content and manage communication plans. I regularly translate technical SEO and web development concepts into accessible language for clients, ensuring they understand the value of our work. This experience has taught me to adapt my message to different audiences, a skill I see as essential for this position.

I am highly organized and proactive, with experience coordinating multiple projects simultaneously. At Episto, I manage content calendars, track performance metrics, and ensure timely delivery of materials. I am proficient in PowerPoint, SharePoint, and Forms, and I am quick to learn new tools like Sway. My technical background also allows me to create visual materials using Canva and other design tools.

I am fluent in English and have a working knowledge of Dutch (B1), with Turkish as my native language. I thrive in multicultural environments and am eager to collaborate with roll-out managers and local communication specialists across China, Italy, Spain, and the UK.

I am particularly attracted to Atlas Copco's culture of rapid development and individual contribution. I am confident that my positive energy, strong coordination skills, and passion for clear communication will allow me to make an immediate impact on the GEMS program.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
